title: What my PandaDoc spec forgot

segments.text: Here's how to reverse engineer PandaDoc from a written spec. Claude passed all twenty-nine checks, and my spec still had eight gaps.
The full spec is free at personal software factory dot com. If you build it, tell me what broke. I'm Sam. See you tomorrow.
